item.title: 2002 Cadillac Escalade AWD at No Reserve
item.description: This 2002 Cadillac Escalade has 55k miles and is powered by a 6.0-liter Vortec V8 that drives all four wheels through a four-speed automatic transmission and a locking rear differential. Finished in White Diamond over Shale leather, the truck is equipped with a power sunroof, chrome 17" aluminum wheels, heated first- and second-row seats, removable third-row seats, cruise control, automatic climate control, a cassette stereo, a multi-disc CD player, and a Bose sound system. item.title: 11k-Mile 2007 Lamborghini Gallardo Nera Coupe
item.description: This 2007 Lamborghini Gallardo coupe is one of 185 Nera examples produced, and its history includes registration in California and Montana as well as a sale on BaT in December 2024. Finished in Nero Noctis over Nero Perseus and Bianco Polar leather, the car is powered by a 5.0-liter V10 paired with a six-speed E-gear automated transaxle. item.title: 4,200-Mile 2012 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Coupe at No Reserve
item.description: This 2012 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG coupe has 4,200 miles following registration history in California from new through the current owner's recent purchase in 2026. Powered by a 6.2-liter M156 V8 paired with a seven-speed AMG Speedshift MCT automatic transmission, the car is finished in black over black leather upholstery. item.description: This 1968 Buick Riviera was refurbished and modified with a supercharged 6.2-liter LSA V8 and a four-speed automatic transmission before the selling dealer's recent acquisition. The body is finished in two-tone Argent Silver and Graystone, while the cabin is outfitted with black vinyl upholstery, a power-operated front seat, air conditioning, power windows, Dakota Digital gauges, and a touchscreen infotainment system. item.title: 1954 Rolls-Royce Silver Dawn
item.description: This 1954 Rolls-Royce Silver Dawn was delivered new to Eli Lilly International Corp. of Indianapolis, Indiana, in April 1953, and it spent time in Wisconsin and Virginia before being exported to Kuwait in 2001 and re-imported to the United States in 2022. A refurbishment in the 1990s included a respray in blue, and power is from a 4.6-liter inline-six paired with a four-speed automatic transmission. item.title: 23-Years-Owned 1995 Acura NSX-T
item.description: This 1995 Acura NSX-T shows 59k miles through the current owner's purchase in 2003, and it is powered by a 3.0-liter VTEC V6 paired with a four-speed automatic transaxle. Finished in Berlina Black over tan leather, the car is equipped with 16" and 17" ICW Racing wheels, a limited-slip differential, a removable body-color roof panel, pop-up headlights, power-adjustable seats, automatic climate control, cruise control, and a Bose sound system. item.description: This 2025 Ferrari 296 GTB was specified from the factory in Nero DS with Giallo Modena graphics as part of the Assetto Fiorano Package, which added carbon-fiber front corner splitters, a Lexan rear window, redesigned carbon-fiber door panels, and Multimatic shocks. item.title: 1993 Porsche 911 RS America Gemballa Slantnose RSR 3.8 Conversion
item.description: This 1993 Porsche 911 left the factory as an RS America example, and it was subsequently modified by the German-based tuning company Gemballa for use as a display vehicle for their North American division. Modifications were completed in Germany and included retrofitting slant nose-style bodywork with fixed headlamps as well as quarter panel air intakes and a Gembella RSR-style rear wing, front and rear valances, and side skirts.
